scripts.check: pnpm -r check && pnpm -r --if-present lint && pnpm check:worker && pnpm check:ai && pnpm check:docs && pnpm check:secrets
scripts.check:worker: uv run --directory apps/worker ruff check . && uv run --directory apps/worker ruff format --check . && uv run --directory apps/worker pyright
scripts.test: pnpm -r --if-present test && uv run --directory apps/worker pytest -q
scripts.seed:publish:clean: uv run --directory apps/worker --env-file .env python seed_publish.py clean
scripts.nsfw:model: mkdir -p apps/worker/models && curl -fL -o apps/worker/models/nsfw.onnx https://huggingface.co/onnx-community/nsfw_image_detection-ONNX/resolve/1ceb3c7fe1e9f3f2507e6df577437f23a9149fd5/onnx/model_quantized.onnx && echo 'd9afb1e057104e6cc8616d174f0f6a8b8b0389c839eea7d5efa4bdf1a77efd27  apps/worker/models/nsfw.onnx' | shasum -a 256 -c
scripts.checkpoints:run-now: YOUTUBE_FAKE=true uv run --directory apps/worker --env-file .env python -m worker.run_once checkpoint
scripts.seed:performance: YOUTUBE_FAKE=true uv run --directory apps/worker --env-file .env python -m seeds.performance
